expected_findings.summary: The commit message claims begin() now keeps its previous offset, but begin() is unchanged: it still assigns _drain_offset()'s 0 into self._offset, so an all-malformed drain still wipes a live cursor.
test_begin_preserves_offset_on_all_malformed_batch never calls begin(); it asserts _safe_drain_offset() directly, so the test named for the fix does not exercise the function that carries the bug.
